problems: The blind guess ('unrecognisable: scattered blue line fragments') misses the subject. The gold kite skeleton is readable, but the kite is not clearly a silhouette. The blue strokes are fragmentary and read as scattered lines rather than a kite body with a torn edge.

Labels collide heavily: 'torn top-right tip of the kite' overlaps 'top apex of the kite', 'left corner of the kite' and 'belly knot' overlap the star markers and each other, 'bottom point' runs into 'belly knot', and 'frayed end of the cut string' overlaps 'outer strand tip of the frayed string end'. Several labels are truncated at the frame edge.

The belly knot star (82273) sits at the left edge of the kite body near the left corner, not clearly in the centre of the kite where the bridle is tied. Its marker is also much larger than the others, so it reads as a different kind of point.
The torn top-right tip (77952) sits on the notch, but the blue torn outline does not clearly separate the torn tip from the top apex, so the 'torn' quality is hard to see.
The frayed string end and outer strand (81065, 80047) are very small at the bottom of the tail, and the blue frayed strokes there are barely visible, so the splayed end does not read.
Orientation is correct: apex at top, bottom point below, tail running down to the frayed end. The stars for kite corners, the spine and the trailing string are on the right general parts.
output.advice: Redraw so the kite reads as a filled or outlined silhouette, not a skeleton. Keep the apex (79664) at top, the bottom point (80686) below, and the right wing (76440) and left corner (82129) at the sides, and draw one closed kite outline through them. Move the belly knot (82273) to the kite's centre where the bridle meets the spine, and shrink its marker to match the others. Place the torn tip (77952) just outside the top-right edge with a visible jagged notch, and draw a clear torn gap between it and the apex. Extend the trailing string from the bottom point to a knot (81852) and then to a splayed frayed end (81065, 80047) with two or three clearly separated strands. Fix the labels: place them outside the figure with leader lines, stagger them so none overlap, and keep all text inside the frame. Replace the scattered blue fragments with one continuous blue silhouette outline of the kite and tail, offset from the gold lines so it is not a copy of them.
